mapper.sql: SELECT p.id AS projectId, p.version AS projectVersion, p.lifecycle_status AS projectStatus, s.id AS stageId, s.version AS stageVersion, s.status AS stageStatus, c.id AS executionContractId, c.binding_version AS contractVersion, v.id AS planVersionId, e.id AS executionId, e.version AS executionVersion, e.round_no AS roundNo, e.status AS executionStatus FROM proj_project p JOIN proj_project_plan_version v ON v.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND v.project_id=p.id AND v.id=p.active_plan_version_id AND v.status='EFFECTIVE' AND v.deleted=b'0' JOIN proj_project_stage s ON s.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND s.project_id=p.id AND s.id=#{query.stageId} AND s.deleted=b'0' JOIN proj_project_stage_execution_contract c ON c.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND c.project_id=p.id AND c.stage_id=s.id AND c.id=#{query.executionContractId} AND c.graph_version=s.graph_version AND c.effective_to IS NULL AND c.deleted=b'0' JOIN proj_project_node_execution e ON e.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND e.project_id=p.id AND e.node_kind='STAGE' AND e.node_instance_id=s.id AND e.contract_id=c.id AND CAST(e.node_key AS BINARY)=CAST(c.source_node_key AS BINARY) AND e.plan_version_id=v.id AND e.current_marker=1 AND e.deleted=b'0' WHERE p.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND p.id=#{query.projectId} AND p.deleted=b'0'
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(round_no),0)+1 FROM proj_project_node_execution WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND project_id=#{query.projectId} AND node_key=#{query.nodeKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE proj_project_node_execution SET current_marker=NULL, version=version+1, updater=#{query.updater}, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND project_id=#{query.projectId} AND id=#{query.executionId} AND plan_version_id=#{query.planVersionId} AND version=#{query.expectedVersion} AND current_marker=1 AND status IN ('PENDING','ACTIVE') AND started_at IS NULL AND submitted_at IS NULL AND deleted=0
mapper.sql: SELECT * FROM proj_project_node_execution WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND project_id=#{query.projectId} AND current_marker=1 AND deleted=b'0' ORDER BY node_kind, node_instance_id, id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM proj_project_node_execution WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND project_id=#{query.projectId} AND deleted=b'0' ORDER BY node_kind, node_instance_id, round_no DESC, id
mapper.update: UPDATE proj_project_node_execution SET status='ACTIVE', admitted_at=#{query.occurredAt}, version=version+1, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND project_id=#{query.projectId} AND node_instance_id=#{query.nodeInstanceId} AND plan_version_id=#{query.planVersionId} AND node_kind=#{query.nodeKind} AND status='PENDING' AND current_marker=1 AND deleted=b'0'

UPDATE proj_project_node_execution SET submitted_at=#{query.occurredAt}, submitted_by=#{query.actorId}, started_at=COALESCE(started_at,#{query.occurredAt}), started_plan_version_id=COALESCE(started_plan_version_id,plan_version_id), submission_note=#{query.note}, version=version+1, updater=#{query.actorId}, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND project_id=#{query.projectId} AND id=#{query.executionId} AND status='ACTIVE' AND submitted_at IS NULL AND version=#{query.expectedVersion} AND current_marker=1 AND deleted=b'0'

UPDATE proj_project_node_execution SET started_at=#{query.occurredAt}, started_plan_version_id=plan_version_id, version=version+1, updater=#{query.actorId}, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND project_id=#{query.projectId} AND id=#{query.executionId} AND plan_version_id=#{query.planVersionId} AND contract_id=#{query.contractId} AND node_kind='STAGE' AND current_marker=1 AND status='ACTIVE' AND started_at IS NULL AND version=#{query.expectedVersion} AND deleted=0

UPDATE proj_project_node_execution SET status='DONE', ended_at=#{query.occurredAt}, result_snapshot=#{query.resultSnapshot}, version=version+1, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND project_id=#{query.projectId} AND id=#{query.executionId} AND status='ACTIVE' AND version=#{query.expectedVersion} AND current_marker=1 AND deleted=b'0'
